entries.label: Rank
entries.desc: Official rank (current season: the latest snapshot; past seasons: the rank carried into the season's last match).

entries.label: Best rank in the season
entries.desc: Best ranking carried into a match in the season.

entries.label: Ranking points
entries.desc: Official ranking points (current season).

entries.label: Race points
entries.desc: Points earned in this season's counted events (Slams, Finals, 1000s, 500s, 250s; no qualifying, Challenger / WTA 125 or best-of-N rule).

entries.label: Points to defend
entries.desc: Points from last season's counted events still inside the 52 weeks.

entries.label: Projected year-end rank
entries.desc: Year-end rank by mean simulated year-end points (season simulation).

entries.label: Finals qualification probability
entries.desc: Probability of qualifying for the ATP / WTA Finals (season simulation).

entries.label: Year-end No. 1 probability
entries.desc: Probability of finishing the year No. 1.

entries.label: Predicted rank (12 or 6 months)
entries.desc: Official rank now x exp(predicted change in log rank) from the breakout model: a ridge regression of the change in log rank over the horizon on the features below, refitted every year on past snapshots only (walk-forward).

entries.label: Predicted change in log rank
entries.desc: The model's prediction of log(rank later) - log(rank now): -0.69 halves the rank number (a rise), +0.41 multiplies it by 1.5 (a fall).

entries.label: Likely range
entries.desc: The 10th to 90th percentile of the predicted rank, from the model's past errors for players in the same rank band (1-20, 21-50, 51-100, 101-150).

entries.label: Breakout probability
entries.desc: P(the rank improves by a third or more and by at least 5 places over the horizon): a logistic fit on the prediction's distance from that threshold at the player's rank and the log rank, walk-forward. Not shown for the top 10.

entries.label: Regression probability
entries.desc: P(the rank worsens by half or more and by at least 5 places, or the player has no tour-level main-draw rank on record at the horizon), fitted like the breakout probability.

entries.label: Predicted Elo change
entries.desc: The same features fitted to the change in overall Elo over the horizon (inactivity pulls Elo towards 1500, so long absences show here too).

entries.label: Reasons
entries.desc: The largest feature contributions to the prediction against the average snapshot (coefficient x standardised value, in log-rank units, shown as a % change in rank): what moves this player's forecast.

entries.label: Ranking v model
entries.desc: log(official rank) - log(the rank the model implies). Positive: the ranking is worse than the model's rating (underrated by the ranking); negative: overrated.

entries.label: Age curve
entries.desc: The mean change in log rank over the next 12 months by age at the snapshot, all snapshots since 2008 / 2009 (dates of birth from the WTA API and ESPN).

entries.label: Elo trend
entries.desc: Overall Elo now minus six months ago.

entries.label: Rank trend
entries.desc: log(rank now) - log(the rank six months ago) where both are on record (negative = rising).

entries.label: Days out
entries.desc: Days since the last rated match (tour level, qualifying, Challenger / WTA 125).

entries.label: Matches in 12 months
entries.desc: Rated matches in the last 12 months (the sample behind the ratings).

entries.label: Points to defend
entries.desc: Tour-level ranking points from the last 12 months that drop off within the horizon (Slams, Finals, 1000s, 500s, 250s; Challenger / WTA 125 and ITF points are not in the data).

entries.label: Expected points at this level
entries.desc: The mean tour-level points earned over the horizon by players the model rated at the same implied rank, all past snapshots: set against the points to defend, the points calendar.

entries.label: Tour-level share
entries.desc: Tour-level points in the ranking / official points: low means a ranking built mostly on Challengers or ITF events.

entries.label: Market v Elo
entries.desc: The rating of the player implied by the closing line (the market reference) minus Elo's over the last 12 months (Elo points, shrunk towards 0 by 10 matches): the breakout model's one market input.

entries.label: Close-match luck
entries.desc: Wins minus the sum over completed matches of P(win | share of games won): the Pythagorean expectation s^k / (s^k + (1 - s)^k), k fitted per best-of on matches to 2017 (about 20 for best of three). Winning the close ones beyond what the games deserve.

entries.label: Pythagorean expected wins
entries.desc: The sum of P(win | share of games won) over the completed matches (from the share of points won where WTA statistics exist: the points-based expectation).

entries.label: Tiebreaks over expected
entries.desc: Tiebreaks won minus the chain's P(win the tiebreak) from both players' serve and return strength.

entries.label: Deciding sets over expected
entries.desc: Deciding sets won minus the chain's P(win the set) under the set's rule.

entries.label: Points-to-games conversion
entries.desc: Expected wins from games minus expected wins from points (WTA matches with statistics): turning points into games. Shown, but not counted as luck: it persists from season to season.

entries.label: Break points saved over expected
entries.desc: Break points saved minus break points faced x (the player's serve points won outside break points + the tour's pressure offset).

entries.label: Break points converted over expected
entries.desc: Break points converted minus chances x (the player's return points won outside break points + the tour's offset).

entries.label: Draw luck
entries.desc: Sum of Elo P(win v the actual opponent) - the mean Elo P(win) v the typical opponents met at that level, round and seed band in earlier years, placed relative to the strength of the event's field.

entries.label: Strength of schedule
entries.desc: Mean opponent Elo minus the typical opponent's at the same level, round and seed band, relative to the other players in the window: the events chosen are included, so it is reported, not counted as luck.

entries.label: Free wins
entries.desc: Walkovers and opponents' retirements received, each worth 1 - P(win at the stoppage) (Elo before the match, sets so far for a retirement).

entries.label: Wins above expectation
entries.desc: Close-match luck + draw luck + free wins: the wins a record owes to luck. It regresses: its season-to-season correlation is close to zero (Validation view).

entries.label: Luck-adjusted win %
entries.desc: (Wins - close-match luck - draw luck) / matches: predicts next season's win % better than the raw win %.

entries.label: Season-to-season correlation
entries.desc: Pearson correlation of a measure in one season with the same measure the next season (players with 20+ tour-level matches in both): near 0 for luck, high for skill.

entries.label: Model rating
entries.desc: The match forecast's blend linearised into one number per player on the Elo scale: w_elo x Elo + (400 / ln 10) x (w_sr x beta x (serve + return rating) + w_gelo x game-share Elo), offset so the active top 100 average as on Elo.

entries.label: Model rank
entries.desc: Order of the model rating among players with a rated match in the last year and 10+ rated matches.

entries.label: Rank the model implies
entries.desc: The official rank held by the player in the same position of the official order: the k-th best model rating gets the k-th best official rank among the same players (those ranked inside the top 300).

entries.label: Points at the implied rank
entries.desc: The official ranking points of the player who holds the implied rank: what the ranking would credit if it followed the model.

entries.label: Surface rating
entries.desc: The model rating on one surface (surface-blended Elo and game-share Elo, the surface serve/return record), its rank, and the gap to the overall rating: a surface specialist's advantage.

entries.label: Market v model
entries.desc: Mean over the player's matches of logit(market) - logit(model), in Elo points: positive = the market reference rates the player above the model. Market reference = the closing line with the margin removed (Pinnacle, else Betfair, else the average) or Kalshi's quote about 4 h before the start. A difference of opinion, not a signal: the market reference is the better forecaster.

entries.label: Expected wins: model, market
entries.desc: Sums of the model's and the market's pre-match probabilities over the same matches, beside the actual wins.

entries.label: Log-loss: model, market
entries.desc: Mean -log P(actual result) of each forecaster on the same matches (lower is better).

entries.label: Rank correlation (Spearman)
entries.desc: Spearman correlation between the predicted and the actual change in log rank, players observed at the horizon; 95 % CI from 400 bootstrap resamples of players.

entries.label: Hit rate of the top 10
entries.desc: Share of each snapshot's 10 most likely breakouts (outside the top 10, by breakout probability) that broke out, and of the 10 most likely regressions that regressed; the base rate is the share among all players.

entries.label: Lift
entries.desc: Hit rate / base rate: 2.5 means the list finds breakouts 2.5 times as often as picking at random.

entries.label: Recall
entries.desc: Share of all breakouts at a snapshot that were in its top-10 list.

entries.label: Brier score
entries.desc: Mean squared error of the breakout / regression probabilities, beside the base rate's.

entries.label: Walk-forward
entries.desc: Each year is predicted by a model fitted only on snapshots whose 12-month (6-month) outcome was known by 1 January of that year; settings chosen on 2010-2017, 2018-2025 reported as the test years.

model.label: Surface Elo
model.desc: Overall and per-surface ratings (hard, clay, grass) with K = a / (n + b)^c decaying in matches played, a fitted surface blend w (a match uses w x surface + (1 - w) x overall), a best-of-five sharpening, a pull towards 1500 after layoffs and entry ratings from the ranking. Every constant fitted on 2005-2019 walk-forward log-loss.

model.label: Serve/return model
model.desc: logit P(i holds v j) = baseline (surface, indoor, best of five, level) + s_i - r_j with per-surface deviations, fitted by penalised maximum likelihood on the exact probability of every observed set score (an exact dynamic programme over service games; the first server is unknown, so both orders are mixed), time-decayed. The WTA fit adds the official point and game statistics as binomial terms.

model.label: Chain-scale hold
model.desc: The hold probability whose i.i.d. point/game/set chain reproduces observed scorelines (used for the match forecasts); the displayed calibrated hold adds the tour's offset learned from real WTA stats.

model.label: Match chain
model.desc: Exact Markov chain point -> game -> tiebreak -> set -> match from the two serve-point probabilities: win probability, set-score, total-games and game-handicap distributions, tiebreak and straight-sets probabilities; deciding-set rules by event and year (advantage, tiebreak to 7, to 10, at 12-12).

model.label: Model probability
model.desc: logit p = w_elo logit(Elo p) + w_sr logit(serve/return p), weights fitted on walk-forward predictions; the serve-point pair is then shifted so the chain returns p, with a small match-level dispersion for distributions.

model.label: Live win probability
model.desc: The same chain from the current score (sets, games, server, points); the serve-point probabilities are held at their pre-match values. Finished matches replay the most likely game order when only set scores are known (marked as reconstructed).

model.label: Leverage
model.desc: P(win | win the game) - P(win | lose it) before a game.

model.label: Excitement
model.desc: The sum of absolute win-probability changes along the match.

model.label: Comeback
model.desc: The winner's lowest win probability during the match.

model.label: Tournament simulation
model.desc: 20,000 Monte Carlo runs of the real bracket (round robin for the Finals) with results so far fixed and each remaining match forecast by the model; the 'if the player wins' chances are reweighted so they measure the match itself.

model.label: Season simulation
model.desc: The rest of the calendar played many times: entry probabilities by level and history, seeded draws, the real points tables and 52-week drops, the Finals round robin. Gives Finals qualification, year-end No. 1 and ranking distributions.

model.label: Draw difficulty
model.desc: Mean expected opponent Elo along the bracket path from the bracket recursion with Elo probabilities at the start of the event.

model.label: Market reference
model.desc: A quiet reference beside our forecasts, never the headline: Kalshi and Polymarket two-sided midpoints (spread <= 12c), with the margin removed across a field; a field is shown only when enough runners are quoted. The closing lines (Pinnacle and the bookmakers' average) from tennis-data.co.uk, with the margin removed multiplicatively.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best among the season's qualified players (a matches floor scaled to the season played), reversed where lower is better; rates are shrunk towards the pool mean by a few pseudo-matches before placing. The surface view compares players with enough matches on that surface.

model.label: Backtest
model.desc: Walk-forward from 2010: ratings use only earlier results, the serve/return model is refitted monthly, blend weights come from earlier years; scored by log-loss and Brier, beside Pinnacle's closing line (margin removed) as the market reference.

model.label: Match Charting Project
model.desc: Shot-by-shot records of selected matches by volunteers (Tennis Abstract), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; style profiles derived here are shared under the same licence.

model.label: Breakout model
model.desc: Quarterly snapshots of the official top 150 since 2008 (ATP) / 2009 (WTA): the change in log rank over 12 (and 6) months on the ranking v the model's rating, age, Elo and rank trends, days out, activity, points to defend, the tour-level share of the points, close-match and draw luck and the market's view; ridge regression refitted every year on past snapshots.

model.label: Luck decomposition
model.desc: A record split into what the performance deserved and what luck added: Pythagorean expectations from games (and points), the chain's tiebreak and deciding-set chances, break-point base rates, draws against the typical draw for the seed band, walkovers and retirements received.

model.label: Model rating
model.desc: One number per player from the match forecast's blend of Elo, serve/return and game-share Elo, on the Elo scale; the basis of the model rank and the over/undervalue table.
